description: Eight consecutive days ending at the fixed instant, so the ratio is 1.0 and lands in the build band. Note that runs_7d and runs_28d count distinct DAYS, not sessions: two runs on one day collapse to one entry. Reaching this band needs every counted day inside the acute window.

disclaimers: Workload ratio, a monitoring signal only. Not an injury probability, risk score or diagnosis.
Stop and seek a qualified clinician for pain that persists, altered gait, chest pain, or any medical concern. Nothing here is a diagnosis.
recommend.limitation: Progression is optional; a repeat week is equally valid.
